verdict.reason: The source says nothing about 17 counties with multipliers below 1 or any published coastal flooding multiplier values. It states a general HM floor ('a HM floor has been implemented for all hazards'), and the coastal flooding HM in Equation 5 is the product of SubHazardFAF and SubHazardProportion, with no explicit MAX(1, ...) shown, so the claim that the formula cannot produce values below 1 is not supported.
